species.real: A ravanne is tuned by warming its goatskin by a fire until it is tight, so a sega night often starts with the drummers gathered round the flames.
species.name: Ravanne

dex.text: A goatskin drum that plays itself at dusk on the old copra floor, a slow rolling beat with a rattle behind it. If you tap your foot you will find you are already dancing. It is not a ghost. It is a party that has not finished.
dex.fact: The ravanne is a goatskin drum, played with a rattle called the maravanne and a triangle for sega, the music and dance of the Chagossians and of Mauritius. Chagossian sega is sung in Chagossian Creole and keeps the memory of the islands alive among a scattered community.
